args.stdin: SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exists_flag FROM product_variants v JOIN product_families f ON v.product_family_id = f.product_family_id JOIN product_variant_properties p ON v.product_sku = p.product_sku WHERE v.brand = 'Festool' AND f.product_family_name LIKE '%Stackable SYS 3JJ-9LM%' AND p.property_key = 'storage_type' AND p.property_value_text = 'tool bag';
